name: ProjectHealthStatusReporter
tagline: Weekly RAG status reports for the whole project portfolio – trend, workflow and exec summary in one app.
description: A complete weekly status-reporting module for consulting and professional-services firms: project managers file RAG reports with five health dimensions, financials, risks and a path to green; the PMO reviews, publishes and rolls them up into a portfolio dashboard, an 8-week trend matrix, a workflow board and an auto-composed executive summary. Budget and schedule RAGs are suggested from EAC and forecast dates, missing and stale reports are chased, and every change flows back to Power Fx.
features: Overall + 5 dimension RAGs with figures-based suggestions
Trend arrows, weeks-in-red streaks, stale and missing reports
Draft → Submitted → Reviewed → Published workflow with return reasons
Bulk actions, drag-and-drop and keyboard moves with undo
Configurable RAG labels, colours, dimensions and thresholds
Demo mode with 16 fictional projects × 8 weeks
Phone layout with bottom view bar
